title: solanum nigrum subsp. ochroleucum
intro: Solanum nigrum subsp. ochroleucum, commonly known as yellow nightshade, is a subspecies of the S. nigrum plant, belonging to the Solanaceae family of flowering plants. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of S. nigrum subsp. ochroleucum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include solasodine, solanine, and chlorogenic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
